MC_DT_FacadeNiche.mountingNotes: Back plane Z=-0.10; facade front +Z. Closed pointed blind niche, fluted engaged pilasters and projecting carved cornice. Base-centred pivot.

MC_DT_QuoinCornice.mountingNotes: Back plane Z=-0.10; front +Z. Alternating chamfered dressed quoins with mortar gaps, broad footing and corbelled cornice; not a passage.

MC_DT_SlateDormer.mountingNotes: Ground/roof pivot centred X/Z, base Y=0. Closed gabled slate dormer with thick roof/eaves and pointed louvred front +Z; seat its low closed base in existing roof.

MC_DT_ChimneyVent.mountingNotes: Ground/roof pivot centred X/Z, base Y=0. Tapered masonry chimney with an actual open supported vent and closed pitched hood; all bars and cap parts are solid.

MC_DT_HeraldicBanner.mountingNotes: Back plate reaches Z=-0.14; front +Z. Solid waving swallowtail cloth with crescent heraldry, forged curved cantilever and brass finials. No texture, transparency or animation needed.

MC_DT_IvyCluster.mountingNotes: Base-centred wall pivot; front +Z. One branching woody vine with 36 thick three-lobed leaves, two green tones and restrained wall projection; no alpha cards.

MC_DT_HerbShrub.mountingNotes: Ground pivot centred X/Z, bottom Y=0. Closed low earth pocket, three herb/shrub stems, broad thick leaves and nine restrained five-petal flower clusters.

MC_DT_YardWinch.mountingNotes: Ground pivot centred X/Z, bottom Y=0. Static raked timber winch with flanged drum, six rope coils, forged handwheel/crank and open tool crate. No gameplay mechanism or collision.

MC_DG_WallGarden24.mountingNotes: 24-wide wall-rooted garden. Backing plane intended RobloxZ=-0.10; front+Z/basepivot0. Three deep sloped corbels support a rough nonplanar stone bowl, convex earth bed, broad rooted plants and hanging vines. No exposed horizontal decorative deck; allgeometryopaque/noncolliding. Place only against verified old vertical wall faces.

MC_DG_WallHoist.mountingNotes: Wall-mount centre pivot. Intended front +Z; two closed timber mount rails on back Z=-0.10, sloped triangulated braces, flanged horizontal drum, six rope coils, forged handwheel and crank. Short closed rope hangs downward. Ground crate and loose tools are omitted; no platform, collision, or gameplay mechanism.
